question: In June 2022, who among the following took an oath as Delhi High Court Chief Justice?
solution:
The correct answer is __Justice Satish Chandra Sharma.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Justice Satish Chandra Sharma on 28 June 2022 took oath as the Chief Justice of the Delhi High Court.
 
• He was sworn in by Delhi's Lieutenant Governor Vinai Kumar Saxena at a ceremony in the Raj Niwas.
 
• Justice Sharma had earlier served as the Chief Justice of the Telangana High Court.
 
• Justice Ujjal Bhuyan also took oath as the Chief Justice of Telangana High Court on 28 June 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Justice Amjad Ahtesham Sayed was sworn in as the 27th Chief Justice of the Himachal Pradesh High Court on 23 June 2022.
 
• He was administered the oath of office by Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar at Raj Bhawan.
 
• Before being appointed the 27th Chief Justice of the HP High Court, Justice Sayed was posted at the Bombay High Court.
 
• Union Government has cleared the appointments of new Chief Justices in six High Courts (HC).
 
• Vipin Sanghi & S S Shinde was appointed as the Chief Justices of Uttarakhand HC and Rajasthan HC respectively.
